routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.prompt:
Good morning. Give Allan a short briefing for today:
1. What was decided or left unfinished yesterday (check memory and the vault daily note).
2. Anything time-sensitive you know about.
3. One thing worth his attention that he hasn't asked about.
Be brief. No preamble, no filler. If there is nothing meaningful to report, say so in one line.

Vault access: read the vault ONLY through the milo_vault_search tool (query yesterday's date). NEVER use the raw read/filesystem tools on vault paths — this is a headless run and those calls are auto-denied, which kills the briefing. If a tool call is denied or returns nothing, do NOT stop: write the briefing from memory alone and still deliver it. The briefing must always be produced.
